name: North Cascades National Park
summary: The American Alps — over three hundred glaciers, more than anywhere else in the lower 48, hung above turquoise lakes on one of the great mountain highways. One of the least-visited national parks in the country, and nobody can explain why.

lodging.name: A Newhalem or Marblemount base
lodging.blurb: Small and few — book ahead, and expect no cell signal on the highway.

foodMustTry.name: A burger in Marblemount
foodMustTry.blurb: The last real meal before the highway climbs.

item.title: North Cascades Highway & Diablo Lake
item.blurb: The jaw-dropping turquoise of Diablo Lake — glacial rock flour suspended in the water is what makes that colour — and the serrated peaks along Highway 20.

commute.scenicNote: South and east over the Cascades.
